components.name: Circle Mint - Accounts API
components.description: Accounts API allows you to easily create and host digital wallets for your customers, and manage transfers of funds across accounts- whether they are within the Circle platform, or in / out of the platform via on-chain USDC connectivity.

components.name: W3S Console - API Keys and Webhooks
Wallet Connection
components.description: Connect wallets to the USDC Bridge

components.name: Agentic Wallet
components.description: Wallet for AI agents, including the policy-enforcing proxy API and Circle CLI

components.name: Agentic Marketplace
components.description: Marketplace at agents.circle.com listing registered agent endpoints

components.name: Bridge Interface
components.description: Transfer USDC across blockchains at bridge.usdc.com

components.name: Circle Mint - Payouts API
components.description: Circle Payouts API allows you to programmatically make fast, global payouts to your customers, vendors, and suppliers. Use traditional methods like bank wires and ACH (coming soon) or make native USDC payouts on supported blockchains.

components.name: Circle Testnet Faucet
components.description: Send testnet USDC and EURC to your wallet to experiment with funds flows in your app or smart contract.

components.name: Circle Mint - CAMT.053 Daily Statements
components.description: ISO 20022 CAMT.053 daily bank-to-customer statement reports
